details:
I lack the ability to acquire a VR headset at the moment, and am thus limited to the desktop mode for this game. Nonetheless I still want to be able to play with my friends. This has led me to notice several issues that make the experience excruciating for a desktop user that causes me to either be unable to interact with certain things or able to, but with very very limited capability. This includes both in-world objects as well as other players.

I have no way to individually move my arms, a luxury that all VR users have that I as a desktop user do not. A solution I thought up was to have some keybind that could be used to move the left or right hand or arm with the mouse while held. You could have holding right click switch to rotating it or something, and even have a bind to lock its position and continue moving around in the world as normal.

Another thing that would be nice is a bind to decouple head and body movement so that I could visually look around without moving my body along with me, as this makes several social interactions more awkward than it should be.

Finally I think it would be wonderful if i could move the camera UI on my screen while it is open. Unlike VR, I can't just have the camera UI off to the side while its open, causing my vision to be obscured. What I would like is a way to reposition the UI or shrink it or even toggle it off entirely without actually disabling the camera and having to pull it out again. It would also be nice if you could mask the camera UI when showing other UI elements through the camera as to lets say, actually see what someone's saying due to their model being too big otherwise.
title: Request to make desktop vrchat less abyssmal
